info.title: FASALYTICS Express API (operational and historical market endpoints)
info.description: Operational endpoints (/health, /health/dependencies, /ready) and the read-only HISTORICAL market endpoints under /api/v1 (Milestone 2.3A). All /api/v1 data endpoints are GET-only and return historical snapshot data: every response carries meta.is_live = false. Four granularities are kept strictly separate: mandi-daily, state-daily, national-monthly and the national monthly WPI index. No forecasts, live data or write operations exist. Contract tests compare live responses with this document.

servers.description: Host-published port (Docker Compose or `npm run dev`)

200.description: Always 200. Read `overall` and each dependency `status`. The request id is forwarded to the intelligence service.
Every configured dependency is healthy (dependencies that are not configured do not block).

503.description: At least one configured dependency is unreachable or could not be verified; `blocking` names them.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Optional correlation id, 8-64 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - . Anything else is replaced by a generated UUID.
The accepted or generated correlation id (also sent to the intelligence service).

message.description: Fixed text; never contains addresses or credentials.

required.description: true when the dependency is configured and therefore gates readiness.

ModelsReport.description: The intelligence service's OWN /ready answer. `ready` only when it returns 200 with model_ready=true. Informational: it never gates the API's readiness.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error body for every failure (never stack traces, paths or submitted values).

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass back as ?cursor= to get the next page. null on the last page.

Pagination.description: Keyset (cursor) pagination: stable order, constant cost on every page.

DataMeta.description: Present on every response. is_live is always false: the data are historical records loaded from static files, never live or current market data.

WpiObservation.description: A dimensionless index value. It is not a price and has no currency or unit.
